title: Pricing plans
createHint: A version holds the pricing rule; a new version never edits the old one.
emptyHint: Create a plan, then publish its first version.
priceHint: In minor units of the plan currency (cents); fractions are kept exactly.
metricHint: The usage metric this price counts, for example api_calls.
unitHint: What one unit is, for example call or minute.
modelHint: How the price is computed; every version of the plan uses it.
